name: Sepang International Circuit
layout: F1 Grand Prix circuit (2026 "Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia")

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap circuit relation 284496 (ways ordered by shared nodes, © OSM contributors), start at its "start" node 1578189278, clockwise
sources.width: Published: 16-25 m (Tilke design; main and back straights ~22 m), mapped per section; no free government orthophoto used
sources.elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (https://copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com/, tile N02 E101), robust median ~250 m
sources.trim: Medium downforce: two long straights balanced against fast esses and Turns 5-8, close to the Spa reference
sources.pitLimit: FIA event notes (Malaysian GP / 2026 Bahrain GP in Malaysia): pit lane speed limit 80 km/h
sources.pitLoss: Historic F1 pit-stop loss ~20-22 s at Sepang (Malaysian GP strategy analyses); approximate
sources.raceLaps: 56 laps scheduled for the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia (4 Oct 2026); results list 55 laps for the winner (race shortened). Not a sprint weekend

notes: Hosted the relocated 2026 Bahrain GP. 15-turn FIA numbering; apexes at curvature peaks. Pit lane between the main straight and Turn 15 exit/Turn 1 entry.
